simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU M3602 family with chip ID 0x3602 (run_dump_openbox_s9_app_starts.py): the "  HACK S9  " bootloader unpacks maincode via LZMA to 0x80000200, initializes the single-core M3602 environment, and jumps to 0x80000200.  The main application prints 'APP  init ok' on UART, executes hundreds of graphics engine (GeM3602) commands drawing the OSD dialogs, and drives the 3-wire TM1628 LED front panel on CLK = GPIO 171, DIO = GPIO 62, STB = GPIO 170 through 'AHAH' -> '1N1t' -> 'OOO2'.

desc: Openbox S9 HD PVR customized update firmware (2012-01-05) by anonymouSX built on the single-core ALi M3602 HD platform with 4 MB SPI flash.
Features single-core M3602 execution without secondary SEE core, TM1628 front-panel status progression, and full OSD rendering via the ALi graphics engine.
